format: Studio / Custom events: the readiness heat-generation planner already uses a recorded random seed
requirement: As found in the code (not a decision): the 'Generate heats' action (readiness/actions.ts generateHeatPlanAction) creates a random UUID seed per run, stores it with the engine version 'danceflow-heat-planner-0.1.0' and an input snapshot (create_competition_heat_plan_run), and buildHeatPlan (heatPlanner.ts) shuffles each first-round division's entries with a seeded xorshift shuffle (seededShuffle, seed '<run seed>:<job key>') before balancedGroups splits them into the fewest groups of near-equal size (sizes differ by at most one). This conflicts with the OD-25 instruction 'no seeded randomization in Studio/Custom this release' and is escalated for an owner/coordinator decision; it is NOT changed here.
interpretation_notes: OPEN ESCALATION, now verified by code reading: the readiness planner is reachable by event managers (Competition workspace > Schedule > Advanced scheduling > Schedule Readiness) with no feature flag; its output is a reviewable proposal and does not change operational heats until a later review/apply step; the seed is recorded with the engine version and input snapshot and the plan is reproducible from them; group size comes from the block's floor capacity, not the Studio default of 8; only first-round entries are shuffled. Two planners exist: floorPlanner (deterministic first-fit, schedule page) and heatPlanner (seeded random plus balanced groups, readiness page). Question for the owner: does 'no seeded randomization is introduced' mean none exists or none is added? Choices: keep and label, restrict, or amend the OD-25 wording. The audit evidence for the final order under OD-10/OD-07 was not examined. Randomness here is a DanceFlow behavior, not a body requirement.
decision_refs: OD-25 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now for Studio/Custom heat planning; Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
